_meta._note: Chapter 67, Final test (ch67-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions at 80 % (9/12 fails, 10/12 passes): reading a لَوْ sentence and what لَوْ does to the verb (q01–02), the result and a negative result (q03–04), an imperfect and a past verb after لَوْ (q05–06), لَوْ لَمْ and لَوْلَا (q07–08), one decision from each part of Al-Alaq (q09–10), and two short exchanges keyed from displayed facts (q11–12). Correct options are placed 3 / 3 / 3 / 3. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 9 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-67-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.

ayah.label: Al-Anbiya 21:22
ayah.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayah.en: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayah.ur: اگر آسمان اور زمین میں خدا کے سوا اور معبود ہوتے تو زمین وآسمان درہم برہم ہوجاتے۔ جو باتیں یہ لوگ بتاتے ہیں خدائے مالک عرش ان سے پاک ہے

ayah.label: Al-Anbiya 21:22
ayah.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا
ayah.en: Had there been gods in them other than Allah, they would both have been ruined.
ayah.ur: اگر ان دونوں میں اللہ کے سوا اور معبود ہوتے تو دونوں تباہ ہو جاتے۔

noor_explanation.en: You finish Chapter 67 able to read a لَوْ sentence, find its condition and result, read the verb by its sentence and follow Al-Alaq.
